audience: 40 field technicians who buy parts on the road and file expenses late
objective: Move the field team onto the new expense policy: 30-day filing, receipts in the app, pre-approval over $250. Replace the old 90-day, email-your-receipts habit.

required_messages.message: Submit expense reports within 30 days of the purchase
required_messages.behavior: File each expense inside 30 days instead of batching them at quarter end
required_messages.common_misrecall: The old 90-day window, or a made-up number like 60 days

required_messages.message: Snap the receipt in the Navan app at the point of sale, never email it
required_messages.behavior: Photograph the receipt in the app when paying, instead of emailing receipts to accounting
required_messages.common_misrecall: Emailing receipts to Denise in accounting, the old process

required_messages.message: Anything over $250 needs manager pre-approval before you buy
required_messages.behavior: Get a manager's approval in the app before any purchase over $250
required_messages.common_misrecall: The old $500 threshold, or approval after the purchase instead of before

check_in_questions: In your own words, what did the song ask you to do differently?
Say you bought a three hundred dollar part tomorrow. Walk me through exactly what you'd do.
